why: The story needs a repository, two environments, a seeding order, an evidence artefact, a gate and a composite route to be testable and repeatable, and no source gives any of them; the legacy story predates the split into services and names none of the target artefacts.
read: Read as test-only defaults that change no production behaviour: the harness calls only the owning services and their fakes, owns no table, writes no entry of rwb-decision, and the composite route is the DP-19 gateway answer and not a call from the browser to each service.

text: The wave 2 harness runs from its own repository and pipeline in two environments, SIT for the run of record and UAT for the acceptance run, with `rwb.p3.plan-timers` on in both and the business clock a harness setting. It seeds every fixture through the owner's contract, or through the WireMock fake in fake mode: cases RW-2026-000201, RW-2026-000202 and RW-2026-000203, the approval entry DLE-9001 at level L4 by U-APR-01, CURE_PERIOD_DAYS 30 and plan.warn-days 3, package RESTRUCTURE version RES-2026.12 with rows R-RES-25, R-RES-27, R-RES-29, R-RES-30 and R-RES-31, and the ten treatments of 2026-12-01 with eight APPROVED and two BOOKED. It writes one evidence report per run keyed by story id and business date, holding one row per criterion with the seam, the answering service or fake, the observed value and pass or fail, plus the run trace, and keeps it with the release record for the wave; it passes the run only when every owned criterion is green and no cross-schema reference, second hop or wrong topic name is found. The treatment and plan sections, the timer view and the deviation view are read through the gateway-bff composite case-record route owned by RWB-PLT-N001-CON, whose path and merge order are agreed with the platform edge owner before the first run.
why: The harness cannot be built, rerun or audited without a stated home, seed set, clock, evidence artefact, gate and composite route, and no source in the set fixes any of them. Every value used above is either a legacy value of RWB-E2-004 or a naming rule of Template and Rules R4 and R5.5, so nothing is invented: the assumption fixes only the test scaffolding, not a business value, a code, a date or an amount.
